scope.description: Control-point graph with orthogonal facts, not a full game state machine or physics simulator.
covered: crew guard at representative load/tick boundaries
opaque: exact AIIntercept2 steering and fuel arithmetic
full selector scheduling and frame timings
population selection and later NPC behavior
notProven: historical cause of each stranded ship
preconditions: Locations represented are OKLG and VORB/VNCA local retrievers.
No higher-priority external reaction, queued directive or StationReturn intent unless an explicit event represents it.
Native planner, collision, health, faction and timing outcomes are externally supplied assumptions/results, not synthesized.
scope.sourceFingerprintPolicy: SHA-256 of UTF-8 decoded text normalized to LF; assembly fingerprint is raw binary SHA-256. Changed files require review, not automatic blessing.

anchors: if (apply) foreach (var co in crew) co.CatchUp()

return.symbol: StationReturn.RunChild / native ordinary mission dispatch / StationReturnFastForwardPatch

station_collision_native.symbol: Ship collision scan/response and projectile/body separation
anchors: private static void ProcessCollision(Ship a, Ship b

station_collision_policy.symbol: Station docking-chain policy and physical prefix

station_collision_scan.symbol: Existing collision/proximity scan with station-attached candidate filtering

source.supports: Native branches read directly; does not recover a historical caller.

retriever_repro.supports: Native SFF/queue/sequence handoff and route/group overwrite reproduced; scene steering/docking boundaries substituted.

lifecycle.supports: Crew registration/execution guards, instant-dock ordering and connected reserve selection; selected Unity boundaries substituted.

arrival.supports: Native retirement, ownership and unregistration; MoveCO, scene and market boundaries substituted.

live_arrival.supports: Four original pilots alive at OKLG/interiors after API arrival. Patrol restoration seen. Fresh fixed SFF pickup not observed.

sff_tests.supports: Captured group/route exclusions and bounded travel/arrival gates; not an end-to-end proof of all regional AI.

depot.supports: Depot ownership/assignment correction; candidate selection and exclusions exercised.

escape_handoff.supports: 60 native caller/production-patch checks with explicit world/weapon/health/plan boundaries; whole police dispatch, shared escape leaves, Navy/Blockade controls and allocation. Full combat remains unexpanded.

avoidance_validation.supports: 844 checks including production native FlyTo replay for three anchors, original failure controls, motion oracle and allocation. Flight geometry/evasion remain unexpanded external outcomes in this transition slice; no live validation claimed.

station_traffic_validation.supports: 880 assertions: live-link scope, native proximity scan, physical prefix with counting body boundary, free-space/projectile/body controls and native shared FlyTo replay of both patrol and returning hauler. Native impact controls fail; production reaches original targets for three anchors. Full geometry remains unexpanded; no live success claim.

main.description: Native StickySequence Main index, not a semantic enum.

active.description: Observed active leaf can lag the next Main index.

crew.description: Readiness summarizes the native alive/conscious/non-player/same-hull policy. Not a crew count.

connected.description: Hull belongs to a physically connected party.

foreign_crew.description: Connected neighbor has crew; says nothing about transfer authorization.

transfer_authorized.description: Intent contract for moving a neighboring crew. Must be established, never inferred from adjacency.

member_route.description: A native NavData exists on the tug.

target.description: Target category; precise object identities remain external.

target_current.description: Target references the current registered object, not a replaced ShipSitu.

anchor_stale.description: Inherited powered/rotating controls have lost their steering authority.

thrust.description: A commanded nonzero acceleration is present.

motion_owner.description: Which modeled update most recently determined motion.

home.description: VORB or OKLG (other) within this first slice; not a claim about Ceres fleets.

depot.description: Whose assignments/ownership feed empty retriever selection.

shallow.description: Source is exactly Shallow, as required by the new handoff patch.

player_party.description: Source/connected party includes player ownership or controlled ship.

tow_eligible.description: Every attached hull passes the handoff patch's non-player derelict filter.

tree_expected.description: The exact six native Main leaves and identity of the returned HaulShip match.

home_available.description: VORB depot lookup availability checks pass.

stale.description: Native IsStale disposal marker, distinct from an invalid object reference.

arrival_accepted.description: Native dropoff trigger and faction disposition accept this crew.

delta_v_positive.description: Native HaulShip DeltaVRemainingRCS > 0; not a universal enforcement model.

selection_succeeds.description: Authored/random/fuel/geometry candidate pipeline yields a target.

pickup_succeeds.description: Instant Dock succeeds under native requirements.

plan_accepted.description: Native FlyToPath accepts a route; planner internals are opaque here.

crew_guard_applicable.description: Crew guard's valid object, load state, role and non-body scope holds.

sff_applied.description: Enabled Orbital SFF actually captured and applied this party's motion.

sff_ready.description: Applied skip meets native-arrival range and speed handoff checks.

operator_eligible.description: ALL ShipArrival preflight checks pass, including updated crew acceptance.

surrender.description: Native threat branch reaches surrender; actor decision is external.

collision.description: Native collision avoidance requests a maneuver.

selected_reserve.description: Native reserve selection selected this hull, before spawning/reset.

undock.label: Undock / Main 0
undock.detail: May remain Running; do not assume detachment in one frame.

target.label: Choose or retain target / Main 1
target.detail: Native low-fuel home selection, authored dispatch, randomized candidates and failure paths.

candidates.label: Empty retriever depot/candidates
candidates.detail: Messages, ownership filters and randomness are not reimplemented.

fly.label: FlyTo / Main 2
fly.detail: Manual or plotted path depends on native target/geometry/collision decisions.

dock.label: Dock / Main 3
dock.detail: Ordinary docking rejects already attached ships; instant path differs.

haul.label: HaulShip / Main 4
haul.detail: Manual group steering, tow braces, collision avoidance and native zero-delta-v stop.

deliver.label: DockCargoAndDespawn / Main 5
deliver.detail: Normal arrival range/speed requirements; instant SFF entry is a different boundary.

queued_haul.label: SFF one-shot HaulShip pending
queued_haul.detail: Wrapper discards Running continuation. Main can still be 2 or 3.

path.label: Plotted member motion
path.detail: Playback sets member pose/velocity and resets spin; not proof group follows.

group.label: Group anchor overwrite
group.detail: Runs after ship updates; inherits anchor controls and does not copy member route.

threat.label: Native threat-response branch
threat.detail: Priority queue precedes this branch. Sequence checks can fail or remain Running.

surrendered.label: Native surrender interaction
surrendered.detail: Not forced successful; resumption/negotiation remains opaque.

flee.label: Native flee: station/SOS/undock/fly/dock
flee.detail: Authored multi-command branch; not a universal return-home rule.

unregistered.label: Stopped/unregistered ship
unregistered.detail: Can be legitimately stranded. Does not mean the hull or people were destroyed.

retired.label: Hidden hull; crew transferred or rejected
retired.detail: Native dropoff may delete rejected people. Hull reuse/cleanup is not eternal persistence.

reserve.label: Hidden reserve lookup
reserve.detail: Native selection is faction/POI dependent and originally permits attached hidden hulls.

reserve_blocked.label: Connected reserve not selected
reserve_blocked.detail: Rejects a lifecycle-invalid reuse candidate, not all hidden ships.

spawn.label: Reuse/reset and create/assign crew
spawn.detail: Assigning crew and positioning remain native; reset does not itself guarantee clean angular state.

load.label: Reconstruct saved AI/tree/crew
load.detail: Native command deserialization is not validated as a full save emulator here.

replacement.label: Ship instance replaced on unload/reload
replacement.detail: Logical registry identity can survive while object references change.

operator.label: Explicit operator station arrival
operator.detail: Not an autonomous fallback; consumes eligible empty wrecks for local haulers.

flee_flight.label: Flee branch FlyTo (not Main)
flee_flight.detail: Separate authored branch/leaf. The Main index is not advanced by this flight.

findings.note: A reproduced route/anchor control conflict, not a claim that every plotted group necessarily runs away.
Ready crew unavailable while commanded thrust persists. Scope excludes intentional uncrewed controllers.
Adjacency alone does not authorize taking a neighbor's crew. Legitimate group returns require a separately established intent contract.
Vanilla disposal policy is recorded, not automatically reclassified as a defect or suppressed for autonomous arrivals.

scenarios.note: Conditional native reproduction. Nonzero first haul thrust and accepted route are explicit assumptions; a blocked later event is reported, not silently invented.
Ordinary successful steering remains available.
Legitimate stranding is not forced into rescue.
Patch intentionally does not claim to fix player-controlled groups; scope exclusion leaves this conditional mechanism reachable.
Unknown native layouts fail closed instead of modifying an arbitrary tree.
Lifecycle guard is containment, not a crew creation or hull disposal rule.
Correct depot identity; native random candidate selection is retained.
Other station behavior remains native.
Applied bounded travel suppresses instant arrival before native handoff range/speed.
Capture exclusions remain explicit: SFF gate cannot protect a group it did not capture.
Blocks premature reuse, not every hidden hull.
Legitimate reserve reuse remains available.
Exact old-instance references are transferred, not arbitrary waypoint clones.
Autonomous authored policy is not silently rewritten by an operator rescue API.
Manual operation requires an explicit event; its absence in vanilla is reported as blocked.
Authored retreat remains a possible conditional path, not a prescribed response to every threat.
No fabricated attached tow on failure. The wrapper's actual failure and sequence resumption require further expansion.
Composed inner Dock prefix and outer retriever postfix. Source-grounded conditional inference, not a new combined native-scene measurement.
Reference trace given successful later native hauling and acceptance. Does not guarantee every repaired ship reaches home.
Bounded SFF travel allows native arrival once actual handoff checks pass.
